blocks.html: Robinsons Land’s celebrity endorser and the country’s Dance Princess Maja Salvador performs during the Grand Opening Event of Robinsons Place Jaro on Thursday, September 8 at 2:00 pm. Ms. Earth 2015 Angelia Ong will be hosting this special show. Joining Maja will be ace performer Billy Crawford and The Hotlegs. Don’t miss out on other exciting events lined-up to celebrate the opening Robinsons Land’s 44th shopping mall, featuring Anijou Iloilo Expo (AI Expo) Cosplay teaser event on Saturday, September 10 and American singer and balladeer Rex Smith on Sunday, September 11.
